ShinyHunters leaked 2.4GB of data from blockchain lender after employee social engineering. Exposed names, DOB, email, addresses, and phone numbers.
ShinyHunters confirmed breach of Vimeo user and customer data. Group actively threatening to leak stolen files unless Vimeo pays ransom.

cve.patch_status: CISA KEV — EXPLOITED — remediate by May 3
cve.summary: Authentication bypass actively exploited since late February. Unauthenticated remote attackers gain full control panel access.
RCE via git push injection in internal X-Stat protocol. Any authenticated user could execute arbitrary commands on backend servers.
Improper access control zero-day exploited in the wild. Unauthenticated RCE via crafted requests. Public PoC on GitHub.
Unauthenticated RCE via crafted IKE v2 packets. Double free flaw. Block UDP 500/4500 as interim mitigation.
Zero-click NTLM hash leak zero-day. Incomplete patch of CVE-2026-21510. APT28 actively exploiting against Ukraine and EU targets.

threat.ttp: Zero-click NTLM hash leak, LNK exploit chain, PRISMEX malware
threat.summary: APT28 actively exploiting newly KEV-listed CVE-2026-32202 zero-day in attacks against Ukraine and EU. Previously exploited incomplete patch of CVE-2026-21510 since December 2025.

threat.ttp: ClickFix initial access, AI-generated Slopoly backdoor, Interlock ransomware
threat.summary: IBM X-Force confirmed Hive0163 using AI-generated Slopoly malware to maintain persistent access. Victims include Texas Tech, DaVita, Kettering Health.

threat.ttp: Malicious npm package, AI vibe-coded malware, secrets harvesting
threat.summary: DPRK threat actor planted AI-generated malicious npm package to steal developer secrets. Active since Oct 2025. Extension of Contagious Interview operations.

news.title: BlackCat insider negotiators sentenced: 4 years each for betraying clients
news.summary: Two former IR firm employees (Sygnia and DigitalMint) sentenced to 4 years each for running BlackCat ransomware attacks against their own clients while posing as negotiators.

news.title: CISA adds 8 exploited flaws to KEV — Cisco, JetBrains, SonicWall deadlines set
news.summary: CISA added 8 exploited CVEs including Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN, JetBrains TeamCity, and SonicWall SMA flaws. FCEB deadlines set for April 23 and May 4, 2026.

news.title: FBI warns of sharp rise in AI-enabled cargo theft targeting logistics sector
news.summary: FBI issued warning to transportation and logistics industry of a sharp rise in cyber-enabled cargo theft with estimated losses surging. AI tools being used to improve targeting.

news.title: CrowdStrike April 2026 Patch Tuesday: 164 CVEs, double March's volume
news.summary: CrowdStrike analysis of April Patch Tuesday flags 164 Microsoft CVEs — double March's count. Highlights IKE RCE, TCP/IP race condition, and RDP Client RCE.
